note: Hand-kept. Stills from Zumi's visit videos, supplied by the video editor. Key = <YouTube video id>@<second>: for a dish (kind dish) the second is that dish's tasting moment in food.json (w), so the frame can only attach to the dish it shows; for a frame of Zumi (kind zumi) it is where the frame comes from. Files live in assets/stills/. Optional pos sets the crop focus, e.g. 50% 30%.
